Name: QoL - PanSlotMod
Author: UselessWeeb
Description:
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds a custom slot exclusively for the Pan tool[/*]
[*]Automatically uses the Pan on panning spots without needing to switch your active item[/*]
[*]Slot position is configurable via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Screenshots[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Slot positions[/b][/size]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Screenshots/PanSlotBelowBoots.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Screenshots/PanSlotBelowTrashCan.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Screenshots/PanSlotNextToTheHat.jpg[/img]

[size=4][b]Usage[/b][/size]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Gifs/AutoPanUsage.gif[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Gifs/AutoPanUsageVer2.gif[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Gifs/ConfigWithGMCM.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Tool Upgrade[/b][/size]
You need to have [b]2 empty slots[/b] in your inventory for the patch to work. Once you have them, the upgrade will automatically appear in your inventory and in the upgradable tools list.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/main/PanSlotScreenshots/Gifs/ClintUpgrade.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Bug[/b][/size]
I tested this without my mod and, for some reason, the pan cannot be upgraded with a full inventory (even though all other tools can be upgraded under the same conditions).

[size=5][b]Translations (i18n) [/b][/size]
PanSlotMod supports community translations! If you'd like to contribute a translation for your language, follow these steps:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to the [i][font=Courier New]i18n/[/font][/i] folder in the mod directory [/*]
[*]Copy [font=Courier New][i]default.json[/i][/font] and rename it using your locale code (e.g., [font=Courier New]es.json[/font] for Spanish, [font=Courier New]fr.json[/font] for French) [/*]
[*]Translate the values in the file - [b]do not modify the keys[/b] [/*]
[*]Submit your translation by opening a [url=https://github.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/pulls]Pull Request[/url] or posting it in the [url=https://github.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod/issues]Issues[/url] tab [/*]
[/list]For a full list of SMAPI locale codes, check the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]SMAPI documentation[/url]. 
Current translations (English and Spanish) are provided by me. Community contributions for other languages are welcome!

[b][size=5]Credits[/size][/b]
Special thanks to the community contributors who helped translate this mod:
[b]Deovos[/b] - French translation
[b]Maatsuki[/b] - Portuguese translation
[b]MrYeti2024[/b] - German translation

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for configuration)[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the mod into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size]
Delete the [font=Courier New]PanSlotMod[/font] folder from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Open the in-game mod menu via GMCM to choose where the custom Pan slot is displayed on your inventory screen.

Source code available on [url=https://github.com/a-Bouchez/PanSlotMod]GitHub[/url].

Downloads.Description: Please remove the Pan from the slot or make sure you have at least one empty inventory slot before updating the mod.
